title: Block operator matrix techniques for stability properties of hyperbolic equations
summary: Inspired by recent developments in the theory of stability results in the context of certain wave type phenomena, we discuss abstract damped hyperbolic type equations given in a block operator matrix form with regards to asymptotic behaviour of their solutions. Under mild conditions on the operators involved we provide criteria establishing strong or semi-uniform stability.
